履修条件
Anyone who is interested in Global Education, Global Education Industry (GEI), Impact and Influence of the GEI are all welcome. The lecture will be in English so students are required to speak and present in English (一部、補助的に日本語で説明することも可能です).
授業概要
本講義では、グローバル教育機関／組織／機構等が、世界各国の教育制度に与えている影響やインパクト等について、多角的な研究の視点から検討する。講義自体は英語で行なう予定であるが、メンバーの構成を見て、一部日本語を利用することも検討する。
This course examines the influence and impact of global educational institutions, organizations, and agencies on educational systems around the world from a variety of research perspectives. The course will be conducted primarily in English; however, depending on the composition and needs of the participants, some Japanese may also be used.

授業計画
1. Introduction and Assign a presenter for each chapter
2. Introduction: Researching the Global Education Industry
3. Serial Entrepreneurs, Angel Investors and Capax Light Edu-Business Start-ups in India: Philanthrophy, Impact Investing and Systematic Educational Change
4. The Political Turn of Corporate Influence in Education: A Synthesis of Main Policy Reform Strategies
5. Advocacy Networkd and Market Models for Education
6. UNESCO, Education, and the Private Sector: A Relationship on Whose Terms?
7. Embedding Education Research in the European Economic Imaginary?
8. The Global Education Industry, Data Infrastructures, and the Restructuring of Government School Systems
9. The Transformation of State Monitoring Systems in Germany, and the US: Relating the Datafication and Digitalization of Education to the Global Education Industry
10. International Education Hubs as Competitive Advantage: Investing the Role of the State a s Power Connector in the Global Education Industry
11. The Globalized Expert: On the Dissemination and Authorization of Evidence-Based Education
12. Digitalization, Disruption and the "Society of Singularities": The Transformative Power of the Global Education Industry
13. Writing Global Education Policy Research
14. Conclusion: Changing Education in the GEI-Rationales, Logics and Modes of Operation
15. Overall Discussion
